verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a dedicated Memory Export feature that produces structured, machine-readable exports via customizable Pydantic schemas, plus open-source self-hosting gives full data/stack ownership avoiding lock-in. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that export actually covers full memory history, no documented export format examples (e.g., JSON/CSV sample) or third-party corroboration of the export feature working in practice.
